text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Romania's press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Romania's economic potential is much higher than level shown by statistics, trade minister Dan Popescu says in interview.
- Renel RA electricity authority to collect 1.7 trillion lei from debtors.
- Democratic Convention and Social Democratic Union to start negotiations on new government.
- Over one million Romanians will have a mobile phone by year 2006 following implementation of a digital GSM system in the country, the paper says.
- Bucharest Commodities Exchange to offer 25,000 tonnes of scar iron in tender this month.
- Tests at nuclear reactor in Cernavoda to be completed by end-November.
- Romania to export 500,000 tonnes of maize in 1997.
- High exchange rate of dollar on black market affects retailer prices, the paper says.
All newspapers carry reports on Sunday's presidential run-off. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
